0.0.1.en: Initial alpha release with Salus Cloud login, device pairing, and live temperature and humidity readings.

0.0.2.en: First publish-quality update with metadata, image, and packaging fixes.

0.0.3.en: Updated app and driver artwork for the App Store and pairing experience.

0.1.0.en: Introduced thermostat control with Homey on/off standby behavior, responsive local state updates during Salus cloud sync, and improved operating-mode reliability so idle cooling no longer flips back to heating from ambiguous cloud flags.

0.2.0.en: More reliable Salus cloud connection with automatic session refresh and recovery. Account credentials moved to secure storage, with a repair option to update a changed password without re-pairing. Official app and device artwork.

0.3.0.en: Adds support for Salus smart plugs (SPE600) with energy metering and underfloor heating wiring centres (CB12RF/KL08RF) with pump, boiler and zone status. Thermostats gain battery status, heating and cooling activity with insights and flow cards, and a preset selector to follow the schedule, hold or standby. Adding more devices no longer asks for your login again.
